item.title: Cursed Villagers Add-On
item.creator: HorizonBlocks
item.description:
Add NEW VILLAGERS to ANY world! Explore new CURSED VILLAGES and TRADE with the new Cursed Villagers with this Add-On! 

+ Villager TRADING 
+ Angry VILLAGERS
+ SPECIAL ITEMS (Totems, Food, Weapons, Scrolls) 
+ CURSED GOLEM 
+ Random generated VILLAGES 
+ Stackable with other Add-Ons

faqEntries.heading: Where can I find the Cursed Villages?
faqEntries.content: Cursed Villages generate in Forest and Plains biomes

howToEntries.heading: Cursed Villages
howToEntries.content:
"Cursed Villages" generate across "Plains" and "Forest" biomes. 

There you can find some weird built houses, farms, "Cursed Cats", "Two Headed Golems" and "Cursed Villagers".

howToEntries.heading: Cursed Villagers
howToEntries.content:
Approach the Cursed Villagers with caution. Their unusual and unpredictable behavior often causes them to react aggressively. 

Despite their strange nature you can still trade with them, if you dare to get close enough. 

Villager types: 
- Cursed Cleric
- Cursed Farmer
- Cursed Librarian 
- Cursed Smith 
- Cursed Nitwit

The different villagers will trade you various new and useful items (totems, scrolls, special food, weapons). 

Hint: They'll often show you items they won't trade with you. Sometimes, Cursed Villagers just want to get rid of their useless stuff.

howToEntries.heading: New items
howToEntries.content:
"Totem of Gravestone": Creates a gravestone on death that will save your items. 
"Totem of Fire Resistance": Grant Fire Resistance effect on 50% health 
"Totem of Health Boost": Grants Healt Boost effect when your health falls to 50% or lower. 
"Totem of Speed": Grants Speed effect when your health falls to 50% or lower. 
"Fried Rabbit Foot": Launches you upwards when consumed. 
"Fried Spider": Be able to crawl upwards on blocks when consumed. 
"Cursed Apple": Applies strong Strength effect when consumed. 
"Lifesteal Scroll": While held in offhand the dealt damage will be transfered to your health 
"Saturation Scroll": While held in offhand it grants you Saturation effect. 
"XP Scroll": While held in offhand it occasionally grants bonus experience orbs from killing mobs. 
"Goat Hammer": Flings mobs and players into the air after being hit. 
"Poison Sword": Applies the poison effect to mobs and players after being hit.

Hint: All of the items above can be traded with Cursed Villagers. 

"Stinky Fish": These are dropped when you kill Cursed Villagers. Can be used to tame Cursed Cats.

howToEntries.heading: Cursed Well
howToEntries.content:
The Cursed Well generates in the following biomes: 
- Desert 
- Jungle

Hint: Can feature a cursed house in a small cave below the well.
